positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Tech lead of an Android team with 12 engineers focused on direct to consumer Food Network Kitchen Android app and Fire TV app
* Led performance improvements that decreased 50~70% of the Fire TV app main content launch time on various fire tv devices (Cube, Fires Stick)
* Led Android Payment module development for Magnolia app (Android, AndroidTV, FireTV) within a month allowing the team to meet the aggressive app launch deadline.
* Led several self-started application optimization initiatives: App Bundle migration, image format conversions, memory leaks, ProGuard
* Established Internal engineering guidelines
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Mobile Application Development · GraphQL · Performance Analysis · Kotlin · Technical Leadership · Android Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed the service apk, which was critical to have a low tolerance for faults and latency, used by Samsung’s phone and contacts app
* Maximized code reusability by creating a shared library for various clients, which led to higher velocity and lower maintenance
* Led various high profile features for Hiya Caller ID and AT&T Call Protect
* All of the apps were built from scratch using the best engineering practices with MVP and MVVM architecture along with modern libraries such as RxJava, Dagger, Retrofit, Timber, and etc.
* Hiya Apps together serviced more than 85M+ MAUs
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Mobile Application Development · Performance Analysis · Kotlin · Technical Leadership · Android Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Integrated 3rd party vendor application to Samsung native default apps - Setup Wizard, Dialer, Settings, Contacts - by making code changes to each app and Samsung OS (forked Android OS)
* Developed an Automation testing tool and successfully automated basic verification test suites based on UI Automator library
* Managed release of multiple preload applications for AT&T and T-Mobile by working with carriers, Samsung HQ, and 3rd party vendors (Project management)
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Mobile Application Development · Android Development
